# Purpose

This template provides a standardized annual review of a property's overall condition, operational performance, maintenance history, capital improvements, and planning priorities.

The Annual Property Review serves as the executive summary for a property's operational health.

# Usage Notes

Complete one Annual Property Review for each managed property every calendar year.

The completed review belongs in the future Private Operations Repository.

---

# Guiding Principle

A property should improve over time because each year's review informs the next year's priorities.
